name: search_code
description: Search for code snippets, patterns, or symbols across a codebase

query.description: Search query (keyword, function name, or regex pattern)

repo.description: Repository name or path to search in

returns: List of matching code locations with file path, line number, and surrounding context

name: read_file
description: Read the contents of a file from a repository or local filesystem

file_path.description: Path to the file to read

repo.description: Repository name if reading from a remote repo

returns: File contents with line numbers, language detection, and file metadata

name: write_file
description: Write or overwrite the contents of a file

file_path.description: Path to the file to write

content.description: Content to write to the file

create_directories.description: Create parent directories if they don't exist

returns: Confirmation of file write with file size and path

name: edit_file
description: Apply targeted edits to specific lines or sections of a file

file_path.description: Path to the file to edit

edits.description: List of edit objects with start_line, end_line, and new_content

returns: Updated file content diff showing changes made

name: run_code
description: Execute code in a specified programming language
returns: Execution output including stdout, stderr, exit code, and execution time

name: run_tests
description: Run test suites or specific test cases

test_path.description: Path to test file or directory

returns: Test results with pass/fail counts, failed test details, and coverage report if requested

name: lint_code
description: Run linting and static analysis on code
returns: Linting results with issues by severity, file, and line number, plus auto-fix summary if applied

name: format_code
description: Auto-format code according to style rules

check_only.description: Only check if formatting is needed, don't apply

returns: Formatting results with files modified and diff of changes

name: git_commit
description: Create a git commit with staged changes

files.description: Files to stage before committing (stages all if empty)

returns: Commit hash, files committed, and insertions/deletions summary

name: git_diff
description: Show differences between commits, branches, or working tree

target.description: Branch, commit, or file to diff against

file_path.description: Specific file to show diff for

returns: Diff output with file changes, insertions, and deletions

name: git_log
description: View git commit history
returns: List of commits with hash, author, date, and message

name: create_branch
description: Create a new git branch

checkout.description: Switch to the new branch after creation

returns: Branch creation confirmation with current branch info

name: create_pull_request
description: Create a pull request on a remote repository
returns: PR URL, number, and status

name: search_issues
description: Search for issues or bugs in a project tracker
returns: List of issues with number, title, status, labels, assignee, and creation date

name: create_issue
description: Create a new issue or bug report in a project tracker
returns: Created issue with number, URL, and assigned labels

name: install_package
description: Install a package or dependency using the appropriate package manager
returns: Installation result with installed version and any dependency changes

name: search_packages
description: Search for packages in a package registry
returns: List of packages with name, version, description, downloads, and repository link

name: debug_error
description: Analyze an error message or stack trace and suggest fixes
returns: Error analysis with root cause, explanation, and suggested fixes with code examples

name: generate_documentation
description: Generate documentation for code (docstrings, API docs, README sections)
returns: Generated documentation content

name: refactor_code
description: Suggest or apply refactoring to improve code quality

target.description: Target symbol or line range for refactoring

apply.description: Apply the refactoring (false for preview only)

returns: Refactoring suggestions or applied changes with before/after diff

name: get_type_info
description: Get type information, function signature, or documentation for a symbol
returns: Type information, function signature, parameters, return type, and documentation

name: run_build
description: Run the build process for a project

build_command.description: Build command to run (auto-detected if empty)

returns: Build result with success/failure, output, warnings, errors, and build time

name: analyze_dependencies
description: Analyze project dependencies for updates, vulnerabilities, or conflicts
returns: Dependency analysis report with findings and recommended actions

name: create_scaffold
description: Generate boilerplate code or project scaffolding
returns: Generated files with paths and content

name: profile_code
description: Profile code execution for performance analysis
returns: Profiling results with hotspots, timing data, memory usage, and optimization suggestions

name: search_documentation
description: Search official documentation for a library, framework, or language
returns: Relevant documentation excerpts with links, code examples, and related topics

name: get_code_metrics
description: Calculate code quality metrics for a file or project
returns: Code metrics report with scores, trends, and areas needing attention

name: manage_environment
description: Manage virtual environments or containers for development
returns: Environment status and details

name: explain_code
description: Get a detailed explanation of what a code snippet or file does
returns: Code explanation with purpose, logic flow, key concepts, and potential issues

name: compare_branches
description: Compare two git branches showing differences
returns: Branch comparison with commit differences, file changes, and conflict areas
